name: tutorial-actions
title: Tutorial Actions
description: Coach-mark gestures drawn over the page in one thin-line style, never in the way of input. Mobile: tap, double-tap, long-press, swipe in any direction, scroll with a moving scrollbar, pinch, spread, two-finger rotate, pull to refresh and drag. Desktop: click, double-click, click-and-hold, right-click with its menu, hover, scroll wheel, drag and drop, drag-to-select and keyboard shortcuts, plus modifier keys held over any press (Shift-click). A mouse pointer or finger is picked by the device or forced. Targets are refs, elements, points or functions, tracked every frame. Reduced motion holds every gesture in a still pose.
